intent: Eight original diary tasks compare expectation with actual8-minute timing,match tomorrow worksheets versus old notices to opposite picture destinations,attachtwo to the returned books,and limit one success,remaining reminders and an untried plan. Named evidence slots make each required relation visible. Fresh12-minute desk transfer rejects both invented weekly completion and universal fixed duration.

workshop.title: 用事实认识自己：预计、实际和下一步
workshop.instruction: 点图片配去向，把预计与实际分别接好；别把计划当完成，也别把一次结果当永久标签。

items.label: 预计和实际分开放
items.prompt: Which clues show that sorting took less time than the writer expected?
items.answer: The writer expected a whole evening, but the recorded task took eight minutes.
items.reason: 原先预计一整晚，实际6:10到6:18只用8分钟。要比较原先预计和这次记录，不能只看一个钟点就推出今后都很快。
items.hint: 先区分预计和实际，再分清物品去向、一次结果和未来计划。
items.material:
TUESDAY'S SMALL CHANGE
I used to say, 'I can never keep my school bag organised.'
Today, I thought sorting the bag would take the whole evening.
I began at 6:10 p.m. and finished at 6:18 p.m.
I put old notices in the paper recycling tray.
I put tomorrow's worksheets in a red folder in the front pocket.
I returned two borrowed books to the library earlier that day.
This was one small change, not proof that every future job would be easy.
I still needed reminders for some tasks.
Tomorrow, I plan to check the bag after dinner.
I have not tried that evening check yet.

transfer.passage:
ONE DESK, ONE TRY
Sam expected clearing his desk to take forty-five minutes. He started at 7:05 p.m. and finished at 7:17 p.m. He plans to sort his desk every Saturday, but he has not tried that weekly plan yet. He writes, "This one task went better than I expected. It does not mean every future task will be easy."
transfer.stem: Which statement is supported by Sam's record?

options.text: Sam has already followed the Saturday plan every week.
The recorded task took twelve minutes; the weekly plan has not been tried yet.
All Sam's future tasks will take exactly twelve minutes.

answer.display: The recorded task took twelve minutes; the weekly plan has not been tried yet.

explanation.strategy: 把预计、实际、计划和推断分开；只让实际起止钟点决定本次用时。

steps.text: 7:05到7:17是12分钟；45分钟只是做之前的预计。
steps.reason: 实际记录替换预计来回答这次花多久。

steps.text: 每周六整理仍是尚未尝试的计划；原文也明确不把一次结果推广到未来所有任务。
steps.reason: has not tried yet与does not mean给出了两条限制。

distractors.reason: 把尚未尝试的每周计划说成已经每周执行。
把这次12分钟推广成以后所有任务固定12分钟，超出原文。

explanation.pitfall: 预计不等于实际，计划不等于完成，一次结果也不是永久能力标签。
